description.value: Koto Sushi is a high-end Japanese restaurant in downtown Victoria serving sushi and broader Japanese cuisine in a signature red-and-black dining room. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients prepared with traditional Japanese technique and contemporary presentation. Both a lunch menu and a fuller multi-course dinner menu are offered, with online ordering available.
